key_insight: AI can help unify mechanism discovery, prediction, and design strategies to understand and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic halide perovskites (CsPbX3).
engineering_relevance: This framework supports more reliable perovskite devices by guiding stability diagnosis, lifetime modeling, and targeted materials/process engineering.
evidence_signal: The review highlights that current studies are constrained by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and limited uncertainty quantification.
watch_item: A major challenge is poor protocol consistency and weak transferability across datasets and domains, which can limit model reliability in practice.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
